Jared's take on Highgate

Towers by Kingsway and low-rises and townhomes on the quieter streets around Highgate Village make Highgate the Edmonds condo pocket. Edmonds Station is close, and the Byrne Creek ravine trail runs behind the blocks.

Highgate home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

15 houses sold in Highgate with a median price of $1,500,000 (the middle half sold between $1,420,000 and $1,645,000), taking a median of 57 days to sell at 96.5% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $686 per square foot, a median year built of 1955 and a median lot of 6,000 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Highgate?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 5 houses listed in Highgate. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Highgate a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Highgate had a sales ratio of 20% on only 5 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Highgate from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Between June and October 2026, 7 houses sold in Highgate; Burnaby as a whole recorded 251.

faq.q: Which elementary school is on these streets?
faq.a: Morley Elementary is the elementary school on Highgate's own streets. The Province lists Morley Elementary (K–7) at 7355 Morley St, and Edmonds Community Elementary at 7651 18th Ave nearby. School District 41 catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the locator.

Byrne Creek Community Secondary is the secondary school in the Edmonds area. The Province lists it at 7777 18th St (8–12), while Cariboo Hill Secondary at 8580 16th Ave serves East Burnaby. Confirm a specific house in the locator before treating either as its catchment.

Edmonds Community Centre is the recreation centre for these streets. The City lists it at 7433 Edmonds Street with a 6-lane pool, leisure pool with waterslides, 2 full-size gyms, a youth lounge, the Edmonds Centre for 55+, childminding, and a seniors lounge.

faq.q: Does Highgate get SkyTrain or only buses?
faq.a: A Highgate house gets both SkyTrain and buses. Edmonds Station is this centre's Expo Line station, and the City states town centres are served by SkyTrain plus high-frequency and local buses. The 119 also runs Kingsway between Metrotown and Edmonds stations.

faq.q: What did houses in Highgate sell for?
faq.a: 15 houses sold in Highgate from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, at a median price of $1,500,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Highgate?
faq.a: The median was 57 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.5% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
